review.cross_authorization_provenance_assessmen: Child authorization binds its own contract path/SHA and parent Repair2 contract 9e38... and authorization 9643.... The actor and orchestrator both verify each parent updater receipt's contract_sha256 and authorization_sha256 equal the parent provenance values, and verify receipt skill_post_path/SHA bind the supplied learned state. No receipt rewriting or ordinary AUTHORIZED_E1 aliasing is possible because the versioned actor only accepts M1 status strings. Parent provenance is intact.
review.exactly_once_assessment: Execution run_root is new and distinct from parent Repair2 run_root. The orchestrator requires the run root not to exist, creates it, acquires an O_EXCL exclusive lock, and writes a run-start receipt before provider I/O. Parent Repair2 root, lock, failure artifacts, 20 updater calls, and two learned states are not modified or resumed. exactly_once.execution=true and automatic_retry=false are enforced.
review.measurement_only_authority_assessment: M1 contract and preflight authorization both bind measurement_only=true, updater=false, analyzer=false, paper_promotion=false, submission=false, public_benchmark=false. The versioned actor rejects any authorization whose status is not PREFLIGHT_ONLY or AUTHORIZED M1, and rejects the historical Repair2 authorization. No measurement-only authority defect.
review.no_partial_effect_assessment: Contract, authorization, preflight artifact, actor, and orchestrator all bind partial_effect_read=false. The actor summary withholds scores from the measurement summary (scores_withheld_from_measurement_summary=true), and the orchestrator requires the task payload to contain only task_id, failure_family, scores_withheld flag, provider_calls, and pools. No analyzer is run and no scientific conclusion is produced.
nonblocking_notes: The M1 authorization status string AUTHORIZED_E2_R17_DEEPSEEK_V2_REPAIR2_M1_MEASUREMENT_ONLY is distinct from the historical Repair2 status, so the versioned actor cannot be confused by the parent authorization.

The preflight artifact's authorization_sha256 (5bc344de...) differs from the preflight authorization artifact's own SHA because it records the authorization file hash at preflight time; this is consistent with the bound preflight artifact and does not indicate drift.
review.provider_budget_assessment: Contract and authorization bind actor-only total_limit=180 per learned state and per_unit_limit=10. Budget binding is exact.
